post.originalText:
Still amazed that Opus 5.5 built this entire keyboard from a single prompt.

I asked it to build this for the Keyameleon website:
→ Recreate a MacBook keyboard
→ Add key sounds
→ Add a split-flap animation when the keycaps change

It got everything right on the first try. No follow-up prompts needed.

Turn your sound on and try it 👇
